o.text: From Proto-Turkic *at- (“to throw, shoot”). Cognate with Turkish atmak. The sense “to swindle, to fool” is a semantic loan from Russian ки́нуть (kínutʹ).
Likely a calque of Russian тиражи́ровать (tiražírovatʹ). By surface analysis, tiraj + -la.
Ultimately from Persian جوشیدن (jôšidan). Cognate with Turkish coşmak.
From Proto-Turkic *ȫrken (cf. Chuvash вӗрен (vĕren)), a derivation of Proto-Turkic *ȫr-.
